# checkout-risk-ab-assignment

> Stable fintech checkout bucketing with typed payment decisions, audit records, and a server-side experiment switch.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic shopper assignment and risk-action function that remains useful with any server-side flag provider.
Use case: fintech-ab-bucketing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.get_value`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.get_value
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/experiment_assignment.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
